YouTuber Detained at Hyderabad Airport Over Alleged UK Job Fraud

A YouTuber based in the UK was detained at Hyderabad's Rajiv Gandhi International Airport following lookout notices issued against her. The detention is related to allegations of a job fraud scheme targeting individuals seeking employment in the United Kingdom. Police have taken the YouTuber into custody in connection with the case.
